entries.name: service.name
entries.meaning: The service, as OpenTelemetry names it; the project name for a tenant's workers.

entries.name: project.name
entries.meaning: The codebase that emitted the telemetry.

entries.name: environment
entries.meaning: Where it ran. Unset or unknown is production — never silently development.

entries.name: governance.telemetry.contract
entries.meaning: Which telemetry contract this emitter speaks. Absent: a pre-contract emitter.

entries.name: agent.owner_id
entries.meaning: Who owns the application. Omitted rather than 'unknown' when undeclared.

entries.name: agentsmith.framework.version
entries.meaning: Which AgentSmith runtime library emitted it, when one did.

entries.name: agent.role
entries.meaning: A process with one role for its whole life (the Ops Portal) may state it here; a worker serving many roles never does.

entries.name: service.instance.id
entries.meaning: OpenTelemetry's id for one running instance, when the SDK sets it.

entries.name: telemetry.sdk.
entries.meaning: OpenTelemetry's own SDK attributes (name, language, version).

entries.name: tenant.id
entries.meaning: The tenant the work belongs to. Partitions budget, audit and isolation.

entries.name: agent.role
entries.meaning: Which role did the work (intake, analyst, process-gate, …).

entries.name: run.id
entries.meaning: The run the span belongs to. A span is inside a run when it, or an ancestor, carries this.

entries.name: agent.
entries.meaning: A step's own attributes: the emitter names them (agent_span(**attributes) writes each under `agent.`).

entries.name: agent.step
entries.meaning: The step a span records.

entries.name: agent.kind
entries.meaning: What sort of step: step, retrieval, embedding, …

entries.name: agent.duration_ms
entries.meaning: How long the step took.

entries.name: agent.error
entries.meaning: The exception type a step ended with.

entries.name: agent.name
entries.meaning: The agent or component that did the work.

entries.name: agent.session_id
entries.meaning: A session that groups runs (the reference stacks).

entries.name: project.name
entries.meaning: The project, on a reference stack's root span.

entries.name: agent.owner_id
entries.meaning: The owner, on a reference stack's root span.

entries.name: agent.tool.name
entries.meaning: The tool called.

entries.name: agent.tool.allowed
entries.meaning: Whether the allowlist let the call through.

entries.name: agent.tool.duration_ms
entries.meaning: How long the tool call took.

entries.name: agent.tool.error
entries.meaning: Why a tool call failed.

entries.name: agent.tool.result_count
entries.meaning: How many results a tool returned.

entries.name: input.value
entries.meaning: A payload in: a tool's arguments, a prompt. Redacted by the emitter's profile.

entries.name: output.value
entries.meaning: A payload out: a tool's result, a completion. Redacted by the emitter's profile.

entries.name: llm.model_name
entries.meaning: The model that answered.

entries.name: llm.gateway.tier
entries.meaning: The role, or tier, the call was routed as.

entries.name: llm.usage.reported
entries.meaning: Whether the provider reported token usage — a streamed call may not.

entries.name: llm.usage.input_tokens
entries.meaning: Tokens in, as the provider reported them.

entries.name: llm.usage.output_tokens
entries.meaning: Tokens out, as the provider reported them.

entries.name: llm.usage.total_tokens
entries.meaning: Tokens in and out.

entries.name: llm.gateway.span_source
entries.meaning: Which code opened the LLM span.

entries.name: llm.gateway.cost_usd
entries.meaning: What the call cost.

entries.name: llm.gateway.cost_estimated
entries.meaning: Whether the cost is an estimate rather than reported.

entries.name: llm.gateway.ttft_ms
entries.meaning: Time to the first token.

entries.name: llm.gateway.attempts
entries.meaning: How many attempts the call took.

entries.name: llm.gateway.degrade_reason
entries.meaning: Why the call was degraded to another tier.

entries.name: llm.gateway.prompt_guard.mode
entries.meaning: The prompt guard's mode for the call.

entries.name: llm.gateway.input_guardrail.mode
entries.meaning: The input guardrail's mode for the call.

entries.name: llm.gateway.input_guardrail.redactions
entries.meaning: How many redactions the input guardrail made.

entries.name: llm.gateway.input_guardrail.
entries.meaning: Redactions by kind (email, phone, …).

entries.name: workflow.id
entries.meaning: The workflow the call ran in.

entries.name: prompt.system.sha256
entries.meaning: A digest of the system prompt — the prompt itself never reaches a span.

entries.name: prompt.system.chars
entries.meaning: The system prompt's length.

entries.name: prompt.template.id
entries.meaning: The prompt template's id.

entries.name: prompt.message_count
entries.meaning: How many messages the prompt held.

entries.name: agent.retrieval.hit_count
entries.meaning: How many hits a query returned.

entries.name: agent.retrieval.hit_ids
entries.meaning: The first twenty hit ids.

entries.name: agent.retrieval.top_score
entries.meaning: The best hit's score.

entries.name: agent.retrieval.min_score
entries.meaning: The worst hit's score.

entries.name: agent.retrieval.corpus_size
entries.meaning: How many documents were searched.

entries.name: agent.retrieval.embedder
entries.meaning: Which embedder the store used.

entries.name: agent.embedding.dimensions
entries.meaning: The embedding's width.

entries.name: agent.decision
entries.meaning: What a gate or rules check decided.

entries.name: agent.rule
entries.meaning: Which rule a gate decision applied.

entries.name: agent.exit_code
entries.meaning: The gate's exit code.

entries.name: agent.
entries.meaning: A step: `agent.<step>`, the emitter's own name for it.

entries.name: agent.tool.
entries.meaning: A tool call: `agent.tool.<name>`.

entries.name: agent.retrieval.
entries.meaning: A vector-store query: `agent.retrieval.<backend>`.

entries.name: agent.gate.
entries.meaning: A gate event: `agent.gate.<event>`.

entries.name: llm.
entries.meaning: An LLM call: `llm.<role>`.

entries.name: llm.retry
entries.meaning: A retried provider call, as an event on the LLM span.

entries.name: agentsmith.llm.calls
entries.meaning: LLM calls.

entries.name: agentsmith.llm.duration
entries.meaning: LLM call duration.

entries.name: agentsmith.llm.ttft
entries.meaning: Time to the first token.

entries.name: agentsmith.llm.input_tokens
entries.meaning: Tokens in, per call.

entries.name: agentsmith.llm.output_tokens
entries.meaning: Tokens out, per call.

entries.name: agentsmith.llm.cost
entries.meaning: Spend.

entries.name: agentsmith.llm.cache
entries.meaning: Idempotency cache hits and misses.

entries.name: agentsmith.llm.retries
entries.meaning: Retried provider calls.

entries.name: agentsmith.retrieval.queries
entries.meaning: Vector-store queries.

entries.name: agentsmith.retrieval.hits
entries.meaning: Hits per query.

entries.name: agentsmith.retrieval.duration
entries.meaning: Query duration.

entries.name: tenant.id
entries.meaning: The tenant, on every metric point.

entries.name: llm.model_name
entries.meaning: The model.

entries.name: llm.gateway.tier
entries.meaning: The tier.

entries.name: outcome
entries.meaning: How the call ended.

entries.name: degraded
entries.meaning: Whether the call was degraded.

entries.name: hit
entries.meaning: Whether the cache hit.

entries.name: reason
entries.meaning: Why a call was retried — a coarse class, never a message.

entries.name: backend
entries.meaning: The vector-store backend.
